'''August 2001 Atlanta tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Champion Comics & Games, Atlanta, Georgia on 25 August 2001. [[Ken Brune]] won it. It is known from John Anderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2888">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-atlanta-georgia-8-25-01-championsd2888/ atlanta-georgia-8-25-01-champions], DeckTech (John "Shadow 29" Anderson, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-atlanta-georgia-8-25-01-championsd2888/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Champion Comics & Games, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Ken Brune]]
